description: Example .codex/hooks.json after `contextos init --codex`. `contextos init` writes the absolute interpreter path (`/path/to/python -m contextos codex-hook <Event>`) so the hooks never depend on PATH. PreToolUse is the enforcement point (it blocks with exit code 2); the rest are observation only. Codex runs these hooks only after you trust them in /hooks. Merge into an existing file rather than replacing it; `contextos init --codex` does that for you and keeps other hooks.
